title: Structural Diversity and Differential Natural Pairings of MAT1-1-1 and MAT1-2-1 Proteins Essential for Sexual Reproduction in Ophiocordyceps sinensis Strains.
authors: Li, Xiu-Zhang; Li, Yu-Ling; Liu, Wei; Qi, Jian-Zhao; Zhu, Jia-Shi
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold预测和结构比对分析冬虫夏草MAT1-1-1/2-1蛋白的DNA结合域结构变异与配对模式，虽涉及TF-DNA结合蛋白，但聚焦菌株来源与生殖策略，缺乏结合机制或AI建模方法创新。
abstract: The MAT1-1-1 and MAT1-2-1 proteins perform essential DNA-binding activities and regulation of the transcription of genes governing sexual reproduction in Ophiocordyceps sinensis. Previous studies have documented differential occurrence, alternative splicing, and transcriptional divergence of MAT1-1-1, MAT1-2-1, and pheromone receptor genes in Hirsutella sinensis (Genotype #1 among 17 genome-independent genotypes of O. sinensis fungi). In the present study, we analyzed the natural pairing patterns of structurally variant MAT1-1-1 and MAT1-2-1 proteins simultaneously produced by each of 20 purportedly homogenous O. sinensis strains, based on AlphaFold-predicted 3D structural models and pairwise structural superposition analyses. The differentially naturally paired mating proteins exhibited distinct heteromorphic stereostructures across strains. Specifically, the MATalpha_HMGbox domain of MAT1-1-1 and the HMG-box_ROX1-like domain of MAT1-2-1 displayed variable N- and/or C-terminal truncations, 1-4 amino acid substitutions at distinct sites, and concomitant alterations in hydrophobic properties and secondary/tertiary structural configurations. Thus, the differentially naturally paired but structurally divergent mating proteins support heterogeneous fungal origins within the analyzed O. sinensis strains and are inconsistent with a strictly self-fertilization reproductive model. Our findings suggest that O. sinensis adopts a self-sterile reproductive strategy, potentially involving heterothallic mating or hybrid reproduction during the lifecycle of the LEVEL-II protected Cordyceps sinensis insect-fungal complex endemic to the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau.
abstract_zh: MAT1-1-1和MAT1-2-1蛋白在冬虫夏草（Ophiocordyceps sinensis）中执行必需的DNA结合活性，并调控控制有性生殖的基因转录。既往研究已记录了在中华被毛孢（Hirsutella sinensis，O. sinensis真菌17个基因组独立基因型中的基因型#1）中MAT1-1-1、MAT1-2-1及信息素受体基因的差异性发生、选择性剪接和转录差异。在本研究中，我们基于AlphaFold预测的3D结构模型和成对结构叠加分析，分析了20个据称同质的O. sinensis菌株各自同时产生的结构变异型MAT1-1-1和MAT1-2-1蛋白的自然配对模式。差异自然配对的交配蛋白在不同菌株间表现出明显的异形立体结构。具体而言，MAT1-1-1的MATalpha_HMGbox结构域和MAT1-2-1的HMG-box_ROX1样结构域显示出可变的N端和/或C端截短、不同位点的1-4个氨基酸替换，以及伴随的疏水性质和二级/三级结构构象的改变。因此，差异自然配对但结构分化的交配蛋白支持所分析O. sinensis菌株内的异质真菌起源，且与严格自交繁殖模型不一致。我们的发现表明，O. sinensis采用自交不育的繁殖策略，可能涉及在青藏高原特有的二级保护冬虫夏草昆虫-真菌复合体生命周期中的异宗配合交配或杂交繁殖。
